scripts.start-frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.start-backend: node init && cd backend && npm start
scripts.start: node init && concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "bgBlue,bgYellow" -p "[{name}]" "npm run start-frontend" "npm run start-backend"
scripts.installer: npm i && npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend
